description: Notification sent to a student when their candidacy has been withdrawn or removed from a Student Union election.
subject: Your candidacy for $position has been removed
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is to inform you that your candidacy in the Student Union election has been removed. Any votes that had been cast for you in this election have also been cleared.

Election Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Position:        $position
Election ID:     $election_id
Date Removed:    $date_removed
Removed By:      $removed_by
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What this means:
• You are no longer listed as a candidate for this position.
• Any campaign materials and recorded expenses linked to your candidacy have been removed.
• If this was done in error, or if you would like an explanation of the reason for removal, please contact the Student Union Elections Committee at your earliest convenience.

If you wish to stand again in a future election, you may submit a new nomination once nominations re-open.

Kind regards,
Student Union Elections Committee
University Administration

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
